nom: The Crème Shop Cinnamoroll Under Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Two reviewers who describe themselves as having sensitive skin (one allergic to nearly everything, one with itchy allergy-prone skin) report no burning or irritation and even some soothing relief.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry under eyes said the patches formed to her skin nicely but had zero impact on hydrating that dryness.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the patches felt hydrating, smooth, and dewy, with several noting brighter, moisturized under-eyes; however, a few state hydration was minimal or that liquid dried out before the suggested 15 minutes, and one with dry under eyes felt no real hydrating effect.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers describe sensitive or irritation-prone skin and report no burning, tingling that faded, or a soothing effect on raw, itchy skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer noted the formula is lightweight and does not leave a greasy look after use.

aspects.libelle: Patches feel thin or dry out quickly
Price high for single non-reusable pair

extraits.texte: I have puffy under eyes. I'm not sure if it's due to age, lack of sleep, diet or all of the above. However regardless of the reason I do enjoy a using eye patches from time to time to pamper myself. These under eye patches definitely do the job in the cooling aspect but as far as depuffing I didn't see much of anything. Like most products consistent use is key to seeing results. I suspect I need to use them for a while before noticing a difference. One use is not enough to see any depuffing. They're cute and I did enjoy using them. But for the price I don't think they're worth it even if they're just a couple of dollars since you only get one pair and they're not reusable.

extraits.titre: Super cute and forms to skin nicely
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The Cinnamoroll design was super cute and while that zero impact on hydrating my dry under eyes, it just picked up my mood. The under eye patches formed to my skin well, but I do wish they were more hydrating.

My youngest daughter is obsessed with Cinnamoroll, so I knew that I had to give these a try. A big thank you to The Crème Shop X Hello Kitty and Friends for sending me this product for free in exchange of my honest review. I have a bit of a fixation on the way product packaging feels, so right away this package caught my attention. Opening it was easy, as were the clear instructions on the back of the package. Upon removing them from the inner plastic "container" I immediately fell in love with the hydrogel. These under eye patches are not like most patches that are more papery feeling. These are so soft and smooth with just the right amount of moisture. I generally avoid under eye patches because they make me feel gross with all of the goopy liquid, but these I would most certainly use again. I have sensitive skin and allergic to nearly everything and even though upon initial application I thought that I felt a bit of a tingle (they are cooling and lavender with caffeine), I had no negative reaction. And, of course, I had to give them to my daughter right after.

extraits.titre: Don't forget to peel off the plastic sheet!
extraits.texte: The first thing I want to mention is that is does not say to peel off the plastic sheet in the instructions. It took me a whole 5 mins of wearing to realize this peels off. At first they were not sticking smoothly because of that layer. Once I peeled that off they stuck great. They did not burn my skin as some eye patches do. So if you have sensitive skin, these might work for you! They gave a cooling effect as I worse them which was relaxing. I was not sure I would see any "depuffing" effect, but I think I actually did. My under eyes looked and felt nice and tight and smooth afterwards. They are less messy than other eye patches I have used. All in all, I would give them a thumbs up!

I received this Hello Kitty and friends hydrogel under eye patches in cimaroll and exchange for a fair and honest review. I use these after removing my makeup before bed and left them on her package instructions and felt that they need my eyes feel somewhat soothed. Allergies have been making my eyes itchy and I felt like this offered some relief to mystery kinda raw skin.

extraits.titre: I would buy this eye product !!
extraits.texte: The under eye treatment works really well love the cooling sensation. I use this right after a hot shower. My sample didn't really have a smell. The moisturizer is light weight and does not make me look greasy. They depuff and give you suppleness. I would buy again.

They were super cute and I like the packaging a lot! The packaging made it so the patches stay in the little tray and there's plastic over the patches so your fingers don't have to touch them. I also liked that the underside that went on my face felt like a sheet mask but still jelly. My only complaint is that they didn't seem very wet so they dried on my quicker than the instructed 15 minutes and there was no liquid product left in the packaging to re wet.
